rubric_items.reason: CO-1, CO-2, CO-6, CO-7 and EP-1 to EP-6 match the design. One small gap: the return type of AppointmentRepo.detail changed even though the design says CO-5 is unchanged. The code needs this to compile, and the artifact discloses it under Assumed.

The rule sits in the service and the 404 path is kept. No logging was added. The notices use the doctor page's warning/role=status markup, and the non-null doctor lookup follows the existing reschedule pattern backed by the DOC-5 guard.
Six files, 88 lines added and 3 deleted, all tied to CO-1/2/5/6/7 plus one test file. SUMMARY_SELECT and AppointmentSummary are untouched, and the GEN-SIZE soft check passed.

The code handles closed, already-started and Inactive cases, uses the inclusive >= now window and reuses the timezone-aware withinAvailability. The tests skip the AC4 cap case, the AC5 midnight timezone case, Completed/No-show, and the page's notice order.
The Summary and Changes sections match the diff file by file and in behaviour. One trace slip: C3 is cited for the 'only when Scheduled' behaviour, but C3 only names the component.

findings.text: The design lists AppointmentRepo.detail as existing and unchanged (CO-5), but the implementation narrows its return type. The change is type-only and is disclosed under Assumed, so it departs slightly from the design without changing behaviour.

cites.quote: AppointmentRepo.detail, SUMMARY_SELECT and AppointmentSummary (api, existing): unchanged (A-06)

findings.suggested_fix: Have the design step record AppointmentRepo.detail as a type-only change, or have the stage approver confirm the Assumed CO-5 entry.

findings.text: There are API tests for REQ-1/2/3/5/7/8/9 only. Nothing covers the no-cap case (S-1 AC4), the midnight timezone case (S-1 AC5) or Completed/No-show (S-4 AC2/AC3), and no web test checks that the notices appear in order and only for Scheduled appointments (S-3).

findings.suggested_fix: Add API tests for the 51st-appointment case, the Tuesday 01:00 Asia/Kolkata case and Completed/No-show. Add a web test for AppointmentDetailPage that checks the notice order and that no notice shows on a closed appointment.
